root.name: ハーモニー・ゴールド

rows.ja: 鉱山・事業を買った相手

relations.text: 南アフリカの鉱山はEskomの電力に大きく依存
relations.text_en: Its South African mines depend heavily on Eskom electricity

source.label: Harmony Gold 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: South Africa's mining sector, including our operations, is heavily dependent on electricity supplied by Eskom Holdings SOC Limited (" Eskom "), the state-owned utility, which relies primarily on fossil fuels.

relations.text: パプアニューギニアのワフィ・ゴルプ銅金計画の50:50の合弁相手(Newcrestを買収して継承)
relations.text_en: 50:50 partner in the Wafi-Golpu copper-gold project in Papua New Guinea, via its Newcrest acquisition

source.label: Harmony Gold 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: In November 2023, Newmont Corporation (" Newmont ") completed the acquisition of Newcrest.

relations.text: ワフィ・ゴルプ合弁を50:50で組んだ相手(現在はNewmont傘下)
relations.text_en: Formed the 50:50 Wafi-Golpu joint venture with Harmony; now part of Newmont

source.label: Harmony Gold 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: the WGJV was established as a 50:50 unincorporated joint venture between Wafi Mining Limited (" Wafi Mining ") and Newcrest PNG2 Limited (" Newcrest PNG2 "), subsidiaries respectively of Harmony and Newcrest

relations.text: 豪CSA銅山を持つMAC Copperを2025年10月に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired MAC Copper, owner of the CSA copper mine in Australia, in October 2025

source.label: Harmony Gold 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: On 24 October 2025, following its announcement on 27 May 2025, our acquisition of MAC Copper became effective, adding the operating CSA in New South Wales to our portfolio.

companies.name: アングロゴールド・アシャンティ

relations.text: 2020年にMponeng鉱山を含む南アフリカ事業を買い取った
relations.text_en: Bought AngloGold's South African business, including Mponeng, in 2020

source.label: Harmony Gold 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: On 1 October 2020, Harmony took full control and ownership of Mponeng as part of the acquisition of AngloGold's South African business.

companies.name: カッパー・マウンテン・マイニング

relations.text: 豪エバ銅計画を2022年に買い取った相手
relations.text_en: Sold it the Eva Copper Project in Australia in 2022

source.label: Harmony Gold 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: In 2022, Harmony (through its wholly-owned subsidiary, HGA) purchased the project from CMMC

relations.text: 買収したCSA銅山を20年以上保有・運営していた旧所有者
relations.text_en: Former owner of the CSA copper mine for more than two decades

source.label: Harmony Gold 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: Glencore International AG (" Glencore ") acquired CSA in 1999 and resumed underground mining operations.

companies.name: パプアニューギニア政府

relations.text: ワフィ・ゴルプの許認可手続きで枠組み覚書を締結(2023年4月)
relations.text_en: Signed a framework memorandum on the Wafi-Golpu permitting process (April 2023)

source.label: Harmony Gold 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: Subsequently, the parties entered into a Framework Memorandum of Understanding on 6 April 2023
